method: REST list (or cache) + list-metadata size + MASTER_R2 dot-key probe + HEAD sample + spot SHA-256

checksumStrategy.title: Checksum verification strategy (FAST 8.51)
checksumStrategy.serverSha256Note: Cloudflare R2 does not expose per-object SHA-256 checksums via the REST API.
checksumStrategy.etagNote: R2 ETag values are opaque identifiers (often MD5-based for single-part uploads), not SHA-256.
checksumStrategy.fullContentSha256Note: Phase 8.50 performs full SHA-256 on all 114,498 objects; Phase 8.51 FAST uses list metadata size checks, HEAD sampling, and category spot checks only.
checksumStrategy.spotCheckNote: Phase D downloads ~10 representative objects and verifies SHA-256 against r2-checksums.sha256.
checksumStrategy.jsonTextNormalization: JSON/md/txt objects strip trailing newline before SHA-256 to match export manifest conventions.
